slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to maximize total weekly profit, or is it to minimize total weekly cost while satisfying the requirement that profit is at least 3000 yuan?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and whether it is profit maximization.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about minimizing idle time or any multi-objective requirement involving unused capacity, nor did it ask how such objectives would be weighted. The later catch-all question about other constraints does not clearly target this hidden slot.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Only weekly profit maximization matters; idle-time minimization with cost-proportional weights is not part of the model.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed whether idle time or unused process capacity should be minimized or weighted by hourly cost, but the READY_TO_MODEL summary lists only profit maximization as the objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved, but the P1 idle-time minimization objective was never asked about or confirmed before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent correctly clarified the primary profit-maximization objective and several constraints, but it completely missed the secondary idle-time minimization requirement and stopped with this P1 slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
